text:
maria: quick heads-up — saw a weird spike in egress auth errors during the az reshuffle earlier, looks like keystore path selection flipped to the stale endpoint for some pods.
jon: ugh, that would block GPU node onboarding right? saw several pods stuck in Init waiting on KMS decrypt.
lee: correct, onboarding queue backed up, warm pool drop ~30% for a few mins.
maria: timeline: 1725551200 -> route change applied; 1725553000 -> first decrypt timeouts; 1725555400 -> bulk retry; 1725555500 -> manual reroute.
ash-deploy-bot: deploy started by @maria: hotfix/keystore-path-priority (sha: a1b2c3)
ash-deploy-bot: ✅ rollout completed to 3 AZs (canary ok)
ash-deploy-bot: note: rollback not needed
ashley: what caused the path flip? config drift or a policy?
maria: looks like VPC route table update + our keystore affinity algorithm uses tie-breakers on route metrics. when routes changed, priority calc fell back to lexicographic host compare, picking a decommissioned privatelink endpoint.
jon: we should make the tie-breaker explicit and prefer endpoints with recent health signals, not names.
lee: agreed. short-term: I patched agent to prefer endpoints with health_score > 0.8. patch config:```yaml
keystore:
  endpoint_selection:
    prefer_health_score: true
    fallback_order: ["health_score","latency_ms","route_metric"]
    static_blacklist: ["keystore-legacy-eu-1"]
```
jon: does that require KMS or IAM policy changes?
maria: no IAM changes. just agent logic and a conservative static blacklist that ops can update.
ash-deploy-bot: canary metrics: decrypt_success_ratio rose from 86% -> 99.6% in canary cluster within 2m
ash-deploy-bot: latency p50 for decrypts improved from 220ms -> 85ms
ash-deploy-bot: cost note: we routed ~40k requests temporarily through standby endpoints in us-east, estimate extra egress ~3.2GB (~$0.12) — negligible.
ash-deploy-bot: GPU warm-pool recovered to 98% after fix.
ash-deploy-bot: postmortem task created: infra/keystore-selection-hardening (owner: lee)
ash-deploy-bot: reminder to run audit export for the affected window (1725553000-1725555500) and tag with `keystore-path-flip`
ash-deploy-bot: created ticket CN-4721 in backlog
ash-deploy-bot: ✅ all done
maria: next actions — 1) formalize tie-breaker logic in design doc, 2) add unit tests for route-change cases, 3) add a small pilot that rejects endpoints without recent flowlogs.
ash-deploy-bot: @jon @lee @ashley please ack if you can pick action items, otherwise I'll rotate ownership to platform-oncall in 24h.
jon: ack, I'll own the design doc + tests.
lee: I'll do the pilot for flowlog-based gating.
ash-deploy-bot: thanks — marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
